in_hebrew.name: ניקולא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Nicolea is derived from the Hebrew words 'niko' meaning victory, and 'la' meaning people. Thus, Nicolea can be interpreted as the victorious one among the people.

in_greek.name: Νικόλεια
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Nicolea is derived from the Greek words 'nikos' meaning victory, and 'leos' meaning people. Thus, Nicolea can be interpreted as the victorious one among the people.

in_latin.name: Nicolea
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Nicolea is the same as the Greek and Hebrew names, meaning victory of the people.
